newsitem.title: USA: Unknown gas shuts part of Baltimore airport.
newsitem.headline: Unknown gas shuts part of Baltimore airport.

text.p: An unknown substance forced the closing of parts of Baltimore-Washington International Airport during evening rush hour Thursday, sending 10 people to the hospital, the airport said.
Rescue personnel including hazardous waste crews were searching for what forced the closing of Pier D used by U.S. Airways at about 6 p.m.

The 10 people were taken to area hospitals for non-life-threatening symptom, including headaches, eye irritation and nausea, according to Chuck Brown, spokesman for the Maryland Department of Transportation.
Some passengers said the scent was like pepper spray.
Flights at the pier were cancelled as of 8 p.m., but other part of the airport remained open.
